description: This file contains functions and type definitions for transforming booking field data from API format to internal format, including handling various field types and custom system fields.

methods.name: transformBookingFieldsApiToInternal
methods.description: Transforms an array of booking fields from API format to internal format, processing options if present.

methods.name: getBaseProperties
methods.description: Determines the base properties of a booking field based on its type and specific identifiers, returning a standardized object.

methods.name: transformSelectOptionsApiToInternal
methods.description: Converts an array of string options into an array of objects with label and value properties.
